name: Voicenity
category: AI voice agents for lead qualification
oneLiner: A voice agent that calls your leads, qualifies them in Hinglish, and tells your team who to call back.
audience: Indian sales teams in real estate, education, legal, healthcare and service businesses.
problem: Teams spend hours calling through lead lists before finding who is interested.
capabilities: Calls leads and qualifies them in Hinglish or English
Five industry playbooks: real estate, education, legal, healthcare, service businesses
No-code setup, tested in the browser before going live
Several agents per account, each with its own setup
Per-agent dashboard of calls and qualification outcomes

screenshots.alt: Voicenity homepage: 'Every lead deserves a real conversation.' with Join waiting list and Contact Us buttons

labsNote: Need a voice system Voicenity doesn't cover? Zobique Labs builds custom ones.
